plan.english: Perkʷunos, great striker, hear our word! You who thunder, you who slew the serpent; you who set the waters free, famous are you. The serpent lay among the waters; you struck him, and then the waters went forth to the sea. Now rain on our fields, Perkʷunos.

Perkʷunos, swift striker, hear! You thunder, you give water to the earth; you fill the fields with water. The earth grew dry, you rained, she drank the water, and the grain grew. Fill our fields with water, Perkʷunos.
Perkʷunos, great striker, you came, and the wind blew. The cattle trembled; you thundered, you struck the wolf. It rained. Do not strike us, Perkʷunos; strike the wolf.

Perkʷunos, you are a famous striker. Who slew the serpent, who set the waters free? You slew the serpent, you set the waters free. Who thunders, who gives water to the earth? You thunder, and you give it. Give us imperishable fame.

title: Father Sky, Giver of Good Things

plan.english: Father Sky, you are the giver of good things. You who give light, you who set the stars in the night, you who hear our word well, you who gave the gods their names: bright and famous are you. Now give us good things.

title: Sky and Earth, the Two Parents

plan.english: Father Sky and Mother Earth, hear us, you two! Sky, you stretch above; Earth, you lie below. Sky, you rained; Earth, you drank the water. Guard us, you two.

title: Father Sky, Witness of the Pledge

plan.english: Father Sky, you know the hearts of men; you have seen the pledges of men. Whoever broke a pledge, you struck him, and he died. Hear our pledge now. May you not strike us.
Bright Sky, it grows dark. The sun sank, and the stars are standing. Your stars shine, your moon shines. Protect us. May Dawn, your daughter, come again.
Bright Dawn, daughter of Sky, you shine. You who drive the night away, you who light up the earth, you who bring the sun! You came, and the stars vanished. Come again, Dawn, and bring us the sun.
Dawn, daughter of Sky, you who are red, you lead the cattle out. You came: the sparrow woke, and the cattle stood up. The man drives them forward. Dawn, safeguard them.
Dawn, Night is your sister. Night lay down, and you stood up. The moon sank, and the men woke. Dawn, shining, you come. Give us light, Dawn.
Bright Dawn, you drive swift horses. You who shine, you came forth and became bright. Your two horses stood up, and the men rejoiced. Give us great fame, Dawn.

Bright wheel of the Sun, you shine. You who travel the path, you who bring warmth, you who light up the way! When Dawn arrived, you stood up, and the stars vanished. Great indeed are you, wheel. Give us your splendor.

title: Sun Who Looks on Gods and Men

plan.english: Sun, you look upon the gods and men. You sank, and it grew dark; you stood up, and light came. Sun, climbing the sky, guard us.

title: The Swift Horses of the Sun

plan.english: Sun, your two swift horses carry you. When Dawn arrived, they stood, and you went along the path, you who light up the path. Your path is bright. Give us warmth and light.
Sun, you who ripen the grain, you who heat the water! The water grew warm, the grain grew up, and the men were sated. Do not burn it; ripen it, Sun.
Fire, you are our guest. You who burn, you who warm us! You came to us, you sat down, and we gave you a gift. Do not burn us, Fire. Give us warmth.
Fire, carrying our gifts to the gods, come! You who go to the gods, you arrived, and the gods became glad. They received the gifts. Convey our word to the gods, Fire.
Fire, you light up the night. It grew dark and it grew cold; a wolf came. You stood up, and the wolf went away. Fire, do not vanish; shine on.
Fire, you who burn, you who cook, you who heat the water! The waters grew warm. We ate and were sated. Warm us, Fire.
Waters, our mothers, hear! You who nourish the sheep, you who go to the sea. The serpent enclosed you; Perkʷunos set you free, and you went forth. Do not dry up, and protect us.
Great Sea, great are you. You who swallow the waters! The waters went to you; your fish swim. Sea, do not swallow us; guard us.
Waters, from you the sheep live; from you men live; from you the fish live. It rained from the sky, and you filled the fields. Now, Waters, may you not dry up.

title: Mother Earth Who Holds Up the World

plan.english: Mother Earth, you hold up men and cattle. You who are stretched out, you who are productive! You drank the water and became green. Now carry us, and do not dry up.

title: Mother Earth, We Plough Your Field

plan.english: Mother Earth, we plough your field. You who create the grain, you who feed the cattle! The grain became green, the cattle were sated. Feed us.
Mother Earth, you lie beneath our feet. Whoever lives walks on you; whoever dies comes to you. You drank the water. Love us, and do not leave us.

title: Gods Born of Sky and Earth

plan.english: Now, gods, hear us! You are born of Sky and Earth. You who look upon men, you who give good things! You became strong and went forth. Protect us.

title: Gods Who Give Fame to the Praisers

plan.english: Gods, you are praised. You who heard the praisers, you who set a famous name for them, you who gave imperishable fame! Hear us too.

title: Gods Who Set the Wheel of the Sun

plan.english: Gods, you who set the wheel of the sun in the sky, gods, you who drove the waters to the sea, gods, you who hold up the earth: guard us.
Gods, come to us! You came to our fathers, you drank the libation, and you gave them good fame. Come now to us, and sit down.
Father Sky, we go a long path. Now make our way straight. May we not grow tired. May Dawn lead us.
Gods, may it rain on our fields. May the grain grow, may the sheep be sated. May the earth not dry up, may the waters not vanish.
Father Sky, a guest has arrived. He is dear. We give him gifts, and he has sat down. Hear us, and protect the guest.
Gods, a son is born to us. May he live, may he grow, may he become strong. Protect him, and give him fame.
Mother Earth, you who carry us, we sing your famous name. We are satisfied. Hold us up.
Earth, the hero has died. Protect him. His name is famous. May his fame be imperishable.
Serpent, do not creep to us. Perkʷunos slew you. Die! Poison, dry up!
Wolf, do not go to the sheep. Dog, guard the sheep. The dog is awake, and the wolf is afraid. Sky has seen you.
Heat, go out of the head. Head, become cold. Waters, go to the head. Heat, go away; head, become cold.

title: Charm Against Fear in the Night

plan.english: Heart, do not tremble. A god protects you. Night, lie down. Dawn will come. Heart, become strong.
